lede: EV Body Parts finds body parts for China and EV cars in Singapore, such as Tesla, BYD, Denza, MG, Zeekr and XPeng. Search its catalogue by car and part, or send the car brand, model, year and a photo of the part on WhatsApp. Fitment is checked before you get a quote. It serves workshops and car owners.

services.d: Bumpers, bonnets, fenders, grilles and trims for China and EV cars.
Headlamps, tail lamps and side mirrors, with left or right confirmed before the quote.
Control arms, spring and damper assemblies, knuckles and wheel hubs, including Tesla Model Y parts.
One catalogue and many suppliers, so workshops can ask for several parts in one message.

faqs: China and EV cars such as Tesla, BYD, Denza, MG, Zeekr and XPeng. If your part is not in the catalogue, ask on WhatsApp anyway.
How do I get a price?
Send the car brand, model, build year, the part (and left or right) and a photo on WhatsApp. Fitment is checked first, then you get a quote.
Yes. It serves both workshops and car owners in Singapore.
Are the pictures the actual parts?
No. The catalogue pictures are illustrations. The actual part and its fitment are confirmed before the quote.
